purpose: Define route-based inclusion tests before any public AI pilot is released.
sample_rule: At least 5 participants per persona per pilot; findings remain disaggregated and no weak group may be hidden by an average.

personas.test: reach, understand and complete the core service using signs, paper and a staffed counter
complete the whole route including turning, waiting, service and emergency bypass
personas.failure: any test equipment narrows the clear route below 1.8 m

personas.test: follow tactile continuity, detect zone boundaries and request human assistance
personas.failure: tactile path is interrupted or audible notice lacks a quiet alternative

personas.test: cross the pilot edge without entering the test zone and understand the stop state
personas.failure: child can enter a controlled zone without a physical boundary

personas.test: use the ordinary route and complaint channel outside event hours
personas.failure: basic passage depends on event staffing or bright screens

personas.test: obtain directions, uncertainty warning and human handoff in a supported language
personas.failure: machine translation is presented without confidence or escalation

decision_rule: Any critical failure produces HOLD. Two repeated non-critical failures produce REVISE. Only disaggregated PASS results may support LIMITED_RELEASE.
